get.summary:
The laboratory's channel, its members, the mission relay, the ports and the content

game_name.description: Game account name it enters when not its own login (an existing game user).

game_uid.description: Game user of its game name, created at the first game login, if any.

locked.description: Panel login locked after consecutive wrong passwords.

panel_role.description: admin, gm, leitura or null (no panel access).

ApiError.description: Error body of every refused request.

after.description: JSON text of the state after the change.

before.description: JSON text of the state before the change.

min_price.description: Lowest and highest product price of the category (cash).

delta.description: Positive credits, negative debits; never below zero.

duration.description: Duration in seconds, when the effect has one.

class.description: Item class as the game writes it (lower case).

entering.description: Characters with a channel ticket whose connection has not identified yet.

maps.description: Maps built into the channel and whether each one built.

tooltip.description: What the game's item tooltip shows (stats, enchants, durability, requirements...).

cash.description: Cash balance of the owner's account (what the cash shop reads).

owner.description: Login (game account name) of the owner.

expires_at.description: Expiry as Unix seconds; none for effects without a time limit.

cid.description: Character ID (a 64-bit number, as text for JavaScript).

class.description:
BaseCharacter: 0 Lethita (Lann), 1 Fiona, 2 Evy, 3 Kalok, 4 Kay, 5 Vella, 6 Hurk,
7 Lynn, 8 Arisha, 9 Hagie, 10 Delia (laboratory; domain::character_class).

value.description: JSON text of the new values (none for a removal).

applied_at.description: When the host script applied it (exporters, client copy, game restart).

loaded.description: Version applied over the contents the game has in memory (0: none).

CostumeOption.description: One entry of the model script: what a CostumeType number means.

body.description: The body (`category` of a player_costume.txt entry: fiona, female...).

items.description: Items of the content using it (up to 5) and how many in all.

model.description: The model the client loads for it.

panel_role.description: Panel role; only an admin can give one.

username.description: 3–24 letters, digits or underscore (fits the game's account name).

costume_type.description: CostumeType given to the kit's model.

oneOf.description: Add a row at a free Order, or change the row at that Order.
B4.5: a FeatureMatrix rate in percent (ExpRate_Combat, GoldRate_Story, ...).
QuestInfo DropItemCountMin/Max: how many common monsters of a stage carry a drop.
EnhanceServerInfo SuccessRatio (0–1) of a type and level.

definition.description:
Added items: the definition the content applies (template, set, text, costumes, assets,
set_id), the newest one, pending or published.

edits.description: Item edits of this class not withdrawn (pending and published), oldest first.

fields.description: Editable columns (ItemClassInfo and EquipItemInfo) as exported; missing = 0 or empty.

exported.description: The server's exports have the item (false for an added item not re-exported yet).

origin.description: base, added or edited (a base item with a panel override).

pending.description: An item edit of this class waits to be published.

arg.description: Arg within the enchant's MinArgValue..=MaxArgValue (0 for most).

EnchantOption.description: One enchant the item accepts, with the client's texts.

lines.description: The stat lines (with their conditions) as the tooltip shows them.

target.description: -1 every bag, 0–8 one bag, 100 cash, 103 quest.

item.description: give: an ItemClassEx (`gold`, `longsword[ENHANCE:6]`); remove: a plain class.

exported_version.description: Version the host last re-exported the server's items for (refresh_item_content.py).

published_version.description: Newest published version with an item edit (0 = none).

up_to_date.description:
The server runs the published items; when false, run start-lab.bat (or
scripts/content/refresh_item_content.py) on the host.

ItemDraft.description: The item form (new, clone or edit).

body.description:
Body of the model's player_costume.txt entry (male, female, giant, tall); default: the
template's.

kit.description:
A kit uploaded with POST /api/item-editor/kits: the item gets this model under a new
CostumeType.

set_id.description: Equipment set (SetItemInfo SetID) of an added item.

template.description:
New items: the base item whose rows it copies (a clone of an added item uses that
item's template).

ItemModel.description:
The model of an item: its entry (by CostumeType) in player_costume.txt, the weapon script
of its EquipClass or shields.txt.

model.description: `None` when the item has no model the panel can resolve (hair, accessories...).

category.description: The category text (Weapon, Pants, Consumable, ...) or the raw Category.

constraints.description: Level, class and skill requirements; `ok` when this character meets them.

dye_mask.description: The icon is a dye mask (EquipItemInfo.ColorOverride).

rarity.description: ItemClassInfo.Rarity and its client name (Regular, Beginners, ..., Rare).

set_bonuses.description: Set bonuses by pieces (`ok` once that many pieces are equipped).

stats.description: Item.Stat in ItemStatInfo order; empty for items without stats.

weight.description: GameUI_Heroes_Item_Tooltip_Weight: Item.Stat Weight / 1000 and the base weight.

ItemUsage.description:
Who owns an item class (item editor): its items, the characters holding them, and the
queued deliveries not processed yet.

characters.description: Characters holding the most of them (up to 50).

queued.description: Queued deliveries (mail, rewards) of the class not processed yet.

total.description: Items of the class in every storage (bags, equipment, shared storage).

PickerItem.description: One item as the picker lists it.

class.description: Item class as the game writes it (lower case).

class_restriction.description: ItemClassInfo.ClassRestriction bit mask (bit = character class; missing = none).

description.description:
Filled for the returned page: the English description, the icon background and the
game's tooltip of the plain class (no attributes, no owner).

version.description: The content version the restart applies.

reason.description: feature, special, no_mission, difficulty or requirement.

oneOf.description: EXP through the game's GiveExp (levels up on the way).
Reach this level (the EXP the level table requires).
Reach this level and complete the mission quests up to it (see the plan).
AP through GiveAP (capped like the game).
Acquire a title by its ID.
Add a status effect by Type and level; seconds null = the effect's own duration.

before.description: Level, EXP, AP, acquired titles and status effects before the change.

minutes.description: Minutes until the restart that applies the version (0–60; 0 = now).

oneOf.description: The scheduled restart (absent when the panel runs without the game).

groups.description: Missions in progress (P2P groups) and their member counts.

csrf_token.description: Send back in the X-CSRF-Token header of every POST/PUT/DELETE.

role.description: admin, gm, leitura, or null for an account that only sees its own data.

panel_role.description: admin, gm, leitura or null to remove panel access.

name.description: English name of the NPC, when the client has one.

place.description: Place of the NPC (Colhen, Rocheste, Malina (Morvan), Eventos, ...).

available.description:
The row's FeatureMatrix is enabled in this region, so the client shows it (NotSell,
TestServer and other regions' events are not).

price_count.description: Effective price (the game's PriceCalc of PriceCount).

restricted.description: Rows with a purchase limit are not sold by the laboratory yet.

available_rows.description: Rows the game sells in this region (FeatureMatrix of each row).

npcs.description: NPCs that open the shop, from the NPC talk scripts; empty when none does.

assets.description: Asset folder id (`kit_<16 hex of the zip's SHA-256>`).

model.description: Game path of the studio model.

TradeCategory.description: One marketplace category and its subcategories, in the content's order.

code.description: TradeCategorySub as the items carry it (LONGSWORD, PLATEARMOR_HELM...).

count.description: Items of the export in this subcategory (hidden ones included).

client_refresh.description:
Enhance/Enchant chances also show in the client's own windows: its copy takes them
when opened through start-lab.bat.

live.description:
The game took the values now, without a restart. When false the version stays
published and the next restart applies it.

edits.description: feature, quest_drop, enhance_ratio or enchant_ratio edits (1–300).

TuningView.description: The tunable values the game loaded (published versions included).

enhance_max.description: Largest Enhance level of the item's type; 0 without refining.

before.description: ENHANCE, PREFIX and SUFFIX (with Arg) and tradable, before and after (JSON text).

oneOf.description: The one laboratory channel, when the content configures it.

connections.description: Live frontend connections (login, character list, town).

ports.description: Game ports, in the order the client meets them.
